title: Enforce time, memory, and output limits
description:
As the maintainer, I want runaway programs stopped, so that they cannot hang or exhaust a session.

Feature: Resource limits
  Scenario: An infinite loop is stopped
    Given a program that loops forever
    When the project is run with a 2 second limit
    Then the result reports a time limit exceeded
  Scenario: Huge output is truncated
    Given a program that prints 100 MB
    When the project is run
    Then the captured output is truncated and flagged

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR #1; Gherkin specs pass (26 macOS, 27 Linux in the image).

right_now_summary: Resource limits are merged into develop, and all Gherkin specs pass on macOS and Linux.
